# Logic & Gate

> Logic & Gate is an independent video game studio from Bangladesh that designs, builds and publishes games for Android. It is a sole proprietorship founded on 16 April 2026 by Solayman Islam Ruman (Founder & CEO). Its game Dreadhush is out now on Google Play.

- Legal name: Logic & Gate (sole proprietorship)
- Registered address: South Bhitabaria, Bhandaria, Pirojpur, Barisal Division 8550, Bangladesh
- D-U-N-S Number: 732236869 (Dun & Bradstreet)
- Trade License: 2026927000012, issued by Bhitabaria Union Parishad, Bangladesh
- TIN Certificate: issued by the National Board of Revenue (NBR), Bangladesh
- Contact: support@logicandgate.com
- Google Play developer: Logic & Gate

## Company and legal documents

- [Company Profile](https://logicandgate.com/company-profile.html): company details, registration, management and financial information
- [License & Legal](https://logicandgate.com/license.html): trade license, intellectual property, terms of use, governing law
- [Website Privacy Policy](https://logicandgate.com/site-privacy.html): the website collects no personal data, uses no cookies or tracking
- [Dreadhush Privacy Policy](https://logicandgate.com/dreadhush-privacy.html): privacy policy for the Dreadhush Android game
- [Dreadhush Data Deletion](https://logicandgate.com/dreadhush-delete-data.html): how to delete Dreadhush data
- [Duskthorn Privacy Policy](https://logicandgate.com/duskthorn-privacy.html): privacy policy for the Duskthorn: The Asylum Android game
- [Duskthorn Data Deletion](https://logicandgate.com/duskthorn-delete-data.html): how to delete Duskthorn data
- [Music Copyright & Licence](https://logicandgate.com/music-licence.html): ownership of original music and sound effects
- [Support](https://logicandgate.com/support.html): email support, FAQ, community links

## Games

- [Dreadhush: House of Silence](https://logicandgate.com/dreadhush.html): first-person survival horror for Android, out now on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicandgate.dreadhushproject)
- [Duskthorn: The Asylum](https://logicandgate.com/duskthorn.html): first-person horror for Android, in development
